text: Atmosphere plate. Dense forest at night. Fog between trees. Camera slowly pushes through the fog toward a faint orange glow in the distance.
संगीत — low drone, rising
झींगुर
कुत्तों का भौंकना — abrupt, then dead silence

Medium. Interior of a dimly lit mud house. An old woman (Dadi Kamla) lies on a cot, frail, breathing heavily. A young man (Arjun, 22) sits beside her, holding her hand. Oil lamp flickers. Camera at Arjun's eye level.
गहरी सांस लेने की आवाज़
Dadi's hand goes limp. The oil lamp flickers violently and dies. Complete darkness. Camera holds on Arjun's face illuminated only by moonlight from the window.
संगीत — sharp sting
Wide establishing. Next morning. The village cremation ground beside a river. Smoke rises from a pyre. Villagers stand in a semicircle. Arjun stands closest, face blank. Camera slowly pulls back.

Arjun watches the pyre burn. He looks around — villagers whisper to each other, glancing at him. An old man (Mukhiya ji) catches his eye, then looks away. The smoke rises left-to-right across the frame.
संगीत — low, mournful
Medium. Arjun walks up to Mukhiya ji. Both face camera — Arjun frame-left, Mukhiya frame-right.
हवा चलने की आवाज़ — a sudden cold gust
Wide establishing. Night. Dadi's old house from outside. One window glows with an oil lamp. Surrounding forest is pitch black. Full moon behind clouds.
झींगुर
कुत्तों का भौंकना — distant, uneasy
Medium. Arjun sits on the floor, going through Dadi's old trunk. Old photos, prayer beads, a rusted key, and a cloth-wrapped object. He picks up the cloth bundle.
Arjun unwraps it slowly. Inside is an old, yellowed photograph — a stone temple with a giant serpent carved on it, and a glowing green stone at the serpent's hood. Camera pushes in on the photo.
संगीत — tension building
पायल — faint, rhythmic, growing closer
झींगुर — cut to dead silence
Close. Arjun's face. Eyes widen. He turns toward the window. Camera holds on his face — the moonlight shifts.

Wide. POV from window. At the edge of the forest, about 50 meters away — a woman in white, long black hair, standing completely still. Moonlight illuminates her from behind. Face not visible. She faces Arjun's direction.

The woman stands motionless. Wind moves her hair slightly. Fog curls around her feet. A snake slithers past her feet — she doesn't move. Arjun grips the windowsill. Camera slowly pushes toward the woman, but she remains distant and unclear.
चीखने की आवाज़ — a distant, unearthly wail, not quite human
अचानक ज़ोर से सांस लेने की आवाज़ — Arjun gasps
Close reaction. Arjun stumbles back from the window. Radial speed lines. He looks again — the woman is gone. Only fog remains.

Wide establishing. Next morning. Bright sunlight. The village square. Arjun walks through — villagers stop talking when he passes. Women pull their children inside. Camera follows Arjun left-to-right.
Medium. Arjun stops an old woman. She pulls her hand away.
संगीत — uneasy undertone
Arjun walks back to the house, left-to-right. Cut: his feet on the dirt path. Cut: the old house in the distance, forest looming behind it. He enters. The door creaks shut.
Medium. Interior. Arjun examines the old photograph again. On the back, in faded ink — "नागमणि — कभी मत खोलना" in Dadi's handwriting.
संगीत — discovery sting
Close. Arjun's hands find a hidden compartment in the trunk. Inside — a small brass box, sealed with red thread and vermillion. Snake symbols etched on the lid.
Arjun holds the brass box. His hands tremble slightly. He brings it closer to the lamp. The snake carvings seem to shift in the flickering light.
पायल — sudden, loud, right outside the door
हंसी — a woman's soft laugh, chilling
Close reaction. Arjun drops the box. Camera whips to the door. Radial speed lines.
Medium. Arjun grabs the oil lamp and slowly approaches the door. Camera behind his shoulder. He opens the door — creak.

The doorway is empty. But on the ground, right at the threshold — a trail of fresh marigold flowers leading toward the forest. And in the dirt, footprints — but not human. Snake-trail marks between human footprints. Camera follows the trail into the darkness, then stops.
कुत्तों का भौंकना — frantic, then abrupt silence
संगीत — tension rises
Wide. Arjun steps outside, looks toward the forest. At the treeline — a brief flash of white cloth disappearing between the trees. Gone in an instant.

Arjun follows the marigold trail into the forest. Cut: his feet stepping on dry leaves. Cut: lamp swinging, shadows on tree trunks. Cut: wide shot — Arjun's small figure swallowed by the dark forest, moving left-to-right. The marigold trail glows faintly in the lamplight.
पायल — distant, ahead of him, like guiding him deeper
झींगुर — then silence

Wide establishing. The ruined Naag temple. Massive stone serpent carved over the entrance, broken in places. Overgrown with roots and vines. Moonlight falls directly on the entrance. The marigold trail ends here.
संगीत — grand, ominous reveal
Medium. Arjun stands at the temple entrance, lamp raised. He sees something inside — fresh flowers, lit diyas, as if someone worships here every night.
हंसी — the same woman's laugh, echoing from inside the temple
पायल — from deep inside

Medium. Arjun runs back through the forest, left-to-right. He reaches the village. Bangs on a door — Tantrik Baba Devnarayan's hut. The old tantrik opens the door, sees Arjun's face, and pulls him inside immediately.
संगीत — flashback transition

Wide. FLASHBACK — 300 years ago. Daylight. A grand stone temple, intact and beautiful. A young woman (Nagini priestess) performs rituals. She wears a green stone around her neck — the Naagmani. Everything is golden-lit, warm, peaceful. Camera moves left-to-right along the temple pillars.
Medium. FLASHBACK — A Thakur (Arjun's ancestor) arrives with soldiers. Night. Torches. They break into the temple. The Thakur grabs the Naagmani from the priestess.
चीखने की आवाज़ — the priestess screaming, echoing
संगीत — horror sting
Close. FLASHBACK — The priestess's face as the wall closes around her. Her eyes turn serpentine — green, slit pupils. She speaks through the closing gap.
FLASHBACK ends. Back to present — Tantrik Baba's face in the lamplight. Grave, afraid.
संगीत — doom
Medium. Tantrik Baba stands, opens an old chest. Pulls out a scroll — a hand-drawn map of the temple interior.
संगीत — urgency
Close. Arjun's face — determined, afraid, but resolved. Camera pushes in slowly.
Arjun walks back to Dadi's house alone in the dark. Camera follows from behind, the forest looming on both sides. The house's silhouette against the moonlit sky. He enters. The door shuts.
पायल — very faint, from the direction of the temple
Medium. Interior. Night — the second night. Arjun sits with the brass box on the table. Oil lamp burning. He unwraps the red thread slowly.
संगीत — tension peak
Close. The box opens. Inside — a green, glowing stone. It pulses with light like a heartbeat. The room fills with a faint green glow. Arjun's face in the green light — awe and terror.
पायल — growing louder rapidly
हंसी — right behind Arjun

Close reaction. Arjun spins around. Camera whips. Standing in the doorway — the woman in white. But closer now. Her hair covers her face. Her feet don't touch the ground. Green serpentine eyes glow through her hair. Speed lines, squiggle marks.
अचानक ज़ोर से सांस लेने की आवाज़
Symmetrical portrait. Naagkanya — frontal, centered, floating. Hair parts slightly to reveal half her face — beautiful but terrifying. One eye serpentine green. Snake patterns appear on her skin.
संगीत — horror crescendo
कराहने की आवाज़
Wide. The oil lamp explodes. Complete darkness. Only the Naagmani glows green. In its light — the Naagkanya glides toward Arjun. Snakes pour in from the door and windows.
Darkness. The green glow pulses. Snake hissing fills the room. Arjun scrambles backward, clutching the Naagmani. The glow illuminates the Naagkanya's face inches from his — then blackout.
संगीत — dramatic, continuous under everything

Wide. Morning. Tantrik Baba and villagers rush to Dadi's house. The door is open. Inside — the room is destroyed. Snake skin everywhere. The brass box is empty. Arjun is gone. On the wall, scratched deep into the mud — a serpent symbol.
संगीत — peak
पायल — one last time, fading
Close. The empty brass box. Then cut to: the Naagmani, glowing, sitting on the altar of the ruined temple. Someone placed it there — but not in the right place.
संगीत — final dramatic swell, continues past the last word
हंसी — Naagkanya's laugh, distant, echoing

Wide atmosphere plate — the village at night. Every house dark. Fog rolling in from the forest. The temple ruins visible in the distance, a faint green glow emanating from within. Camera slowly pulls back until the entire village is visible — tiny, surrounded by endless dark forest. The green glow pulses. Fade to black.
